# @ndigo/cache

Isomorphic caching for Ndigo — memory cache manager, memoize, and the @cached decorator

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `CacheMiss` — Branded sentinel returned by Cache#get when no entry exists (or an entry has expired). Distinguishes "no value cached" from a cached `undefined` — compare with…
- `isCacheMiss` — Narrows a cached value to the miss sentinel.
- `CacheOptions` *(type)* — Configuration for a MemoryCache store.
- `Cache` *(type)* — The generic awaitable cache contract. Backend failures reject rather than becoming misses. Cache handles are acquired synchronously through the manager; data o…
- `MemoryCache` — In-memory cache with TTL expiry and bounded-size eviction.
- `resolveCacheName` — Resolves a cache store name from a string or a typed store token (D7): a token-identified store uses the token's description as its name. The single validation…
- `CacheManager` *(type)* — Named-cache registry. Acquires local backend handles synchronously without performing data I/O; the returned Cache operations are awaited. `CachedInterceptor`…
- `CacheManagerOptions` *(type)* — Options for a MemoryCacheManager.
- `MemoryCacheManager` — In-memory CacheManager: auto-creates MemoryCache stores on first `getCache(name)` with the manager defaults. Caches are owned for the manager's lifetime — the…
- `CacheManagerAware` *(type)* — Marks an object that can receive a CacheManager.
- `AsCacheManagerAware` — Mixes cache-manager awareness into a base class.
- `likeCacheManagerAware` — Tests whether a value looks like cache-manager-aware state.
- `cachedSpec` — `@cached` annotation key: the normalized spec recorded for a method. Pass it to `hasAnnotation(...)` to select cached methods.
- `DEFAULT_CACHE_NAME` — The named cache used when a spec omits `cacheName`.
- `CachedSpec` *(type)* — User-supplied `@cached` specification.
- `NormalizedCachedSpec` *(type)* — Canonical `@cached` specification: validated by resolveCachedSpec at decoration time and recorded on `Symbol.metadata` for introspection.
- `resolveCachedSpec` — Normalizes and validates a CachedSpec. Throws at decoration time for malformed specs — in any environment importing the module (the browser included), mirrorin…
- `cached` — Declares that a method is cached.
- `CachedInterceptor` — Single-flight and memoization for `@cached` methods.
- `getCachedSpec` — Reads the spec declared by `@cached` for a method.
- `serializeCacheKey` — Stable string key for an argument list (memoization and `@cached` default key semantics): JSON serialization of the argument array.
- `serializeCacheKeyStrict` — Type-preserving alternative to serializeCacheKey: each argument is tagged with its kind before serialization, so values that `JSON` silently merges are keyed d…
- `MemoizeOptions` *(type)* — Options for memoize.
